name: integration_check
description: Integration link checker running 5 stdlib-only rule categories (init_called, event_balance, state_cleanup, i18n_usage, cross_layer_call) against TypeScript projects

capabilities.name: integration_check.checker
capabilities.description: Run 5 integration rules driven by externalized rule JSON with configurable whitelists and emit structured findings with Markdown/JSON output (checker.py, reporter.py)

storage.description: No persistent storage; rules are loaded read-only from modules/integration_check/rules/*.json
